title: percent_encode: byte-level iteration is the only correct approach
description: The fix from char-iteration to byte-iteration in percent_encode is not merely correct — it's the only correct approach for percent-encoding. The old code iterated chars and cast to u32, producing single-byte percent-escapes for non-ASCII scalars (e.g. U+00E9 → %E9). RFC 3986 requires percent-encoding of UTF-8 bytes (U+00E9 → %C3%A9). The new code iterates s.as_bytes() which is exactly right. A future contributor might propose 'simplifying' this back to chars() — this decision should be defended on the grounds that percent-encoding is defined over octets, not Unicode scalars.
